title: Growth Tribe Lead
full_description:
Build your career. Shape the future of digital banking in Italy.
At ING Italia, you will have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are. We offer a dynamic, inclusive and entrepreneurial environment, empowered by global scale, advanced technology and a strong “Orange Code” culture.
We value diverse perspectives and bold thinking, and we rely on your leadership to continuously improve how we serve our customers in Italy.
As Tribe Lead Growth, you will play a pivotal role inshaping ING Italy’s digital growth agenda, leading cross‑functional teams todeliver a best‑in‑class customer experiencewhile driving sustainable and scalable growth.
The purpose of this role is tobuild and scale a growth enginethat accelerates customer acquisition and development while reducing attrition, leveraging advanced analytics, martech capabilities and digital marketing excellence.
TheGrowth Tribehas full ownership of theend‑to‑end digital sales funnelacross products, with a strong focus on:
Acquiringnew‑to‑bank customers
Activatingnewly acquired and low- or non‑active existing customers
Deepening customer relationships throughincreased product penetration
This role is critical in integratingdata‑driven strategy with end‑to‑end digital execution, ensuring sustainable growth for ING Italia.
Your responsibilities
Lead End‑to‑End Digital Acquisition Strategy
Own and evolve the full digital acquisition strategy across the entire sales funnel.
Integrate performance marketing, SEO, paid media and conversion optimization into a coherent growth approach.
Optimize digital marketing investments by increasing proximity to media auctions and strengthening internal digital media buying capabilities.
Ensure governance alignment with Brand, Marketing & Communications.
Drive Continuous Performance Optimization
Monitor and improve core KPIs including Cost per Acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, customer growth and channel quality..
Drive iterative optimization of landing pages and digital funnels in close collaboration with Product Tribes.
Develop and Execute Customer‑Centric Growth Strategies
Define and implement strategies to accelerate growth in primary, mobile and active customer segments.
Operate autonomously to deliver development and retention initiatives alongside product‑led campaigns.
Orchestrate omnichannel commercial communications and manage a dedicated below‑the‑line (BTL) incentives budget.
Deliver Customer Insights Across Private Individuals (PI) Organization
Provide customer insight services to Tribes.
Foster data fluency across teams by embedding analysts into product squads.
Own customer analytics craftsmanship, methodology and Customer 360° data assets.
Own and Evolve the Martech Ecosystem
Oversee the full Martech stack, including:
A/B testing and experimentation
Campaign orchestration
Content management systems
Attribution and measurement models
Ensure the platform enables scalable, insight‑driven growth initiatives across ING Italia.
Segment‑Specific Martech Enablement
While the Growth Tribe primarily supports the Private Individuals segment, enable Martech solutions for other segments in the Bank.
Ensure clear segmentation ownership, where business logic and strategy remain with each segment.
Advance Growth‑Focused Analytics Capabilities
Develop and deploy advanced analytics models focused on customer growth, lifetime value and churn prediction.
Collaborate closely with Local Data teams and Global Analytics communities.
Lead a high‑performance, purpose‑driven Tribe.
Create clarity of mission and inspire teams around ING’s strategic ambitions.
Ensure strong engagement, capability development and craftsmanship excellence.
Coach and empower leaders to continuously build skills, knowledge and ownership across the Tribe.
Risk, Compliance & Governance
Ensure full compliance with ING policies, local regulation and the ING risk management framework.
Maintain strong understanding of regulatory requirements impacting digital sales and product management.
Ensure risks are identified, documented and managed within agreed timelines.
Leading complex cross‑functional teams in an agile, data‑driven environment.
Building and scaling capabilities required to deliver ambitious growth strategies.
